security_audit.summary: The skill provides useful inference.sh CLI guidance, but several installer paths are confirmed risky, including curl piped to sh and remote manifest command substitution. Many markdown links and placeholder API key alerts are false positives, yet the skill still performs cloud execution and can automate X account actions. Publication should require safer installation guidance, explicit confirmation for side-effecting commands, and clearer credential handling guidance.

remediation.suggestion: Replace curl piped to sh with a pinned release download, checksum or signature verification, and explicit user confirmation before execution.
Avoid parsing remote manifests inside shell substitution. Provide versioned asset URLs and separate verification steps.
Document exact target paths and require confirmation before writing binaries or completions under user home configuration directories.

remediation.issue: External account and paid service actions
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit confirmation before commands that post, follow, send messages, deploy apps, or consume inference.sh credits.
Tell users to store keys in a secrets manager or protected environment, and never paste real keys into prompts or repository files.

content.value_statement: Teams need one way to run many hosted AI apps without custom API wrappers. This skill guides inference.sh CLI discovery, authentication, execution, and result retrieval.
actual_capabilities: Install and authenticate the inference.sh CLI using documented commands.
List, search, filter, and inspect available inference.sh apps.
Run AI apps with inline input or saved input files.
Track asynchronous tasks and save generated results.
Use examples for images, video, LLM calls, search, audio, 3D, and X automation.
limitations: Requires an inference.sh account and local CLI installation.
Runs work on external cloud services and may consume account credits.
Does not validate generated media rights, model output accuracy, or X policy compliance.
Authentication state and API keys are managed outside the skill.

use_cases.title: Prototype AI Media Workflows
use_cases.description: Find image, video, audio, or 3D apps and run quick experiments from the CLI.

use_cases.title: Compare Hosted Models
use_cases.description: Run similar prompts across LLM or media apps and review the outputs in one workflow.

use_cases.title: Operate Content Tasks
use_cases.description: Submit cloud generation jobs, track task status, and collect downloadable output links.

prompt_templates.title: Find an App
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me find inference.sh apps for [task]. Show likely categories, app names, and what input each app requires.

prompt_templates.title: Run One Job
prompt_templates.prompt: Use inference.sh to run [app name] for [goal]. Prepare the input, run the job, and summarize the result.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan and run an inference.sh workflow that creates [asset], improves it with [tool], and saves the final result links.

prompt_templates.title: Evaluate Several Apps
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [models or apps] on [criteria]. Generate sample inputs, run each app, collect outputs, and summarize tradeoffs.

output_examples.input: Find a fast video model for a short social clip.
output_examples.output: The assistant lists candidate video apps, chooses a fast option, explains required inputs, and asks for confirmation before execution.

output_examples.input: Run an image generation job and save the result.
output_examples.output: The assistant prepares the prompt input, runs the selected image app, tracks the task, and reports the download link.

output_examples.input: Compare two LLM apps on a product summary task.
output_examples.output: The assistant runs the same prompt through both apps and summarizes response quality, latency, and practical tradeoffs.

best_practices: Inspect app schemas before sending production data.
Use input files for complex runs, and review them before execution.
Confirm any social posting, paid run, or public output before running the CLI.
anti_patterns: Do not paste private keys, credentials, or unreleased content into model inputs.
Do not pipe remote installers into a shell in unattended environments.
Do not use X automation without review, rate limits, and account owner approval.

faq.question: What does this skill help me do?
faq.answer: It helps agents use the inference.sh CLI to discover apps, run jobs, and retrieve results.

faq.question: Do I need an inference.sh account?
faq.answer: Yes. The CLI requires authentication before running cloud apps or viewing account-specific resources.

faq.question: Can it generate images and videos?
faq.answer: Yes. The references include image and video app examples such as FLUX, Veo, Seedance, and other hosted apps.

faq.question: Does it run everything locally?
faq.answer: No. Jobs run through inference.sh cloud services and may send prompts, files, or metadata outside the local workspace.

faq.question: Can it post to X?
faq.answer: The skill documents X automation apps. Users should require explicit confirmation before any public or account-changing action.

faq.question: Is the installer fully safe?
faq.answer: The current documentation includes curl piped to sh. Use pinned downloads and verification before installing the CLI.
